reader.decision: Draft the corrected migration and the restore statement, not the flag change. Do not run the restore yet; it must be checked against a backup or replica first.
reader.decision_reason: The message names the bad migration as the root cause, and it also hid acme and globex invoices on other screens. The flag route needs flagd, which is unreachable, and it only masks the problem. Drafting is safe because the restore is verified before anyone runs it.

reconstruction.problem: Migration 0042 archived every paid invoice because its WHERE clause had no 90-day age condition. report-builder then used a 3-day-old cached hide_archived flag, which was on for northwind. It excluded all 188 October invoices, logged invoices=0 report=ok, and nobody was alerted.
reconstruction.what_breaks: The northwind October report came out empty. Acme and globex invoices were also wrongly archived and hidden on other screens that read status. A report with 0 rows counts as a success, so nothing alerts.
reconstruction.fix: Add an issued_at < migration time - 90 days condition to the migration. Run a one-off restore that sets status='paid' on archived rows issued inside the 90-day window, after checking it against a backup or replica. Then rerun the report. The fallback is to turn off hide_archived for northwind.
reconstruction.cost: The restore could wrongly un-archive rows that were archived before 25 Oct, if anything was archived inside the last 90 days earlier. The message says no file settles this. The flag fallback brings old archived invoices back into the report and needs flagd, which is unreachable.

follow_up_questions: Was any invoice archived inside the 90-day window before 25 Oct 22:10 UTC? The backup or replica should show it, and the restore depends on the answer.
Is a backup or replica from before the migration available to compare against?
reader.closing_answer: Draft the corrected migration and the restore statement. Write the restore so it is checked against the backup or replica before anyone runs it, and so it only touches rows that the backup shows were paid before the migration. Leave the flag change as the fallback only.
